cohort: The study included 65,742 live singleton offspring from the Japan Environment and Children's Study, enrolled between January 2011 and March 2014, excluding those born via cesarean delivery or with confirmed chromosomal abnormalities.
finding: Labor epidural analgesia was associated with an increased risk of autism spectrum disorder in 3-year-old male offspring (aOR: 2.55; 95% CI: 1.40-4.65), but not in female offspring.
